# AnimeSenpai
> AnimeSenpai is an independent, ad-free anime catalog, tracking, and discovery engine powered by the live AniList GraphQL network and official YouTube trailer embeds.

## Overview & Official Identity
AnimeSenpai (https://www.animesenpai.online/) provides a fast, modern interface for discovering 20,000+ anime titles. Users can explore trending anime, search titles across genres, view broadcast countdowns, watch official trailers, and manage personalized watchlists.
Notice: AnimeSenpai is an independent open-source community platform and is NOT affiliated with third-party anime news blogs or commercial piracy websites.

## Key Endpoints & Capabilities
- [Home](https://www.animesenpai.online/): Hero spotlight, trending anime, seasonal releases, and genre explorer.
- [About](https://www.animesenpai.online/about): Official platform mission, open-source repository, and copyright/DMCA transparency.
- [Discover](https://www.animesenpai.online/discover): Catalog search with filtering by popularity, score, season, year, format, and genres.
- [Watchlist](https://www.animesenpai.online/watchlist): Personal tracking system (Watching, Planning, Completed, Paused, Dropped).
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.animesenpai.online/privacy): Zero tracking, privacy-first data handling.

## Agentic Resources & Tools
- [Security Policy](https://www.animesenpai.online/.well-known/security.txt): RFC 9116 security policy
- [AI Catalog](https://www.animesenpai.online/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Structured agent discovery catalog
- [ARD Manifest](https://www.animesenpai.online/.well-known/ard.json): Agentic Resource Discovery v0.91 manifest
- WebMCP: Client tool `searchAnime` exposed via `navigator.modelContext`
